sources.snippet: This package owns the CT workflow and reuses the public nnunet-mlx engine for model execution. Standard mode runs Dataset291-295; fast and coarse use Dataset297 and 298.

sources.title: MedMLX: On-Device Medical Imaging AI for Apple Silicon
sources.snippet: Adapting a model to new hardware also requires verifying that its results match the original software. Methods: We developed MedMLX, a collection of 21 established medical imaging models rewritten for Apple Silicon in MLX, Apple's machine learning framework. The collection includes nnU-Net, TotalSegmentator, MedSAM2 and SAM 3.
